digest.component_or_area: outbound parent tracking and bridge alerting
propositions: CREATE emit (slot 2) drops a bound non-epic parent silently via logger.debug with no bridge_alerts entry, losing the hierarchy at issue birth
ACLI attach fallback (slot 4) swallows HTTP 400 on parent set with a WARNING but never calls record_parent_divergence, leaving no durable record when Jira rejects the parent
The project's contract (pass_io.py:113-118, dispatch_one.py:561-564) requires a durable operator-visible bridge_alerts entry when an outbound parent cannot reach the tracker, not merely a log line
UPDATE emit (slot 1) and UPDATE apply (slot 3) correctly record parent divergence via the dropped_field_sink→outbound-field-dropped channel, establishing the pattern that slots 2 and 4 must replicate
Unbound parents must remain silent to avoid churn from convergence on later passes, while bound parents that fail to emit must always be recorded
